ARRL 维护，数字签名日志: Maintained by ARRL; digitally signed logs
DXCC 等奖状的主要确认方式，需 TQSL 证书签名上传。: The main confirmation route for awards such as DXCC; logs must be signed with a TQSL certificate before upload.
LoTW 需要 TQSL 证书并签名上传，可复用通联日志导出的 ADIF 文件。: LoTW requires a TQSL certificate and signed upload; the ADIF file exported from the contact log can be reused.
QSL 卡片与 LoTW 是两条独立的确认渠道：同一批通联可以既寄纸卡又走 Lo: QSL cards and LoTW are two independent confirmation channels: the same batch of contacts can go by paper card and by LoTW, and the two flags in the log do not affect each other.
TQSL 可以直接上传；也可以到 LoTW 网站的 Upload File 手动: TQSL can upload directly; alternatively use Upload File on the LoTW site to send the .tq8 manually. After a successful upload LoTW records it as "uploaded"; real confirmation has to wait until both logs are in LoTW.
「{step}」的说明太短，起不到指引作用: The description of "{step}" is too short to be any guidance
「已上传」与「已确认」是两件事：上传只表示 LoTW 收到了你的日志，确认要等对: "Uploaded" and "confirmed" are two different things: uploading only means LoTW has received your log; confirmation requires the other party to upload too, with the key fields matching on both sides.
上传成功后回到本站，点「标记已上传 LoTW」把这一批标成已上传。等 LoTW: After uploading, come back to this site and click "Mark as uploaded to LoTW" to flag that batch as uploaded. Once LoTW has processed it (usually minutes to a day), download the confirmation report (ADIF) from the LoTW site, return to the contact log page and click "Sync QSL": review the differences, adjudicate item by item, then apply.
传播分析、稀有台需求匹配与 OQRS 卡片请求。: Propagation analysis, matching of wanted rare stations and OQRS card requests.
呼号规整成大写: Callsigns are normalised to upper case
在 ARRL 的 LoTW 网站用呼号登录、申请 Callsign Certif: Log in with your callsign on the ARRL LoTW site and apply for a Callsign Certificate; when the .tq6 e-mail arrives, import it into TQSL. The certificate has a validity period, so a new one is needed when you change callsign or it expires.
在 TQSL 里建立 Station Location: Create a Station Location in TQSL
在 TQSL 里选 Sign and upload（或 Sign a log f: In TQSL choose Sign and upload (or Sign a log file), select the .adi you just exported and the matching Station Location, and produce a signed .tq8 file. Signing happens on your own computer; the private key never leaves it.
在线日志与 QSL 管理，社区广泛使用。: Online logbook and QSL management, widely used in the community.
填写呼号、DXCC 实体、CQ / ITU 分区与网格。这里填错不会报错，但会让: Fill in the callsign, DXCC entity, CQ / ITU zones and grid square. Errors here raise no alarm, but will make the QSO judge as "not matched" in LoTW — the zones reported to LoTW are taken from here.
对不上的 QSO 会出现在「同步 QSL」的「本地缺失」里：多半是时间差了几分钟: QSOs that fail to match show up under "missing locally" in "Sync QSL": usually a few minutes' time difference, different spelling of band or mode, or a miscopied callsign in your log.
必须明说「不代签、不碰私钥」: Must state explicitly that it does not sign on your behalf and never touches the private key
把状态回写进日志: Write the status back into the log
本站不做代签：证书与私钥只存在你自己的电脑上，签名与上传都由 TQSL 完成。本: This site does not sign on your behalf: the certificate and private key exist only on your own computer, and TQSL does the signing and uploading. The site only exports the ADIF to be signed and merges the status you write back manually (uploaded / confirmed) into the log.
查不出实体就不算齐全: If the entity cannot be resolved, the data is not complete
步骤名不能为空: Step names must not be empty
步骤太少，多半漏了环节: Too few steps — a stage is probably missing
流程里少了「{keyword}」这一环: The process is missing the "{keyword}" stage
电子卡片交换，与纸质 QSL 类似。: Electronic card exchange, similar to paper QSLs.
电子确认通常比纸质 QSL 更快捷，是现代奖状申请的主流方式。: Electronic confirmation is usually faster than paper QSLs and is the mainstream route for award applications today.
纸质 QSL 仍有纪念意义，可通过 OQRS 或直邮 + 回邮券交换。: Paper QSLs still have keepsake value and can be exchanged via OQRS or by direct mail with return postage.
证书有有效期，到期后上传会被拒；换呼号（例如从 B 类升到 C 类）要为新呼号单: The certificate has a validity period and uploads are rejected after it expires; if you change callsign (for example upgrading from class B to class C) you must apply for a separate certificate and create a new Station Location.
通联日志页点「导出 ADIF」，得到整库的 .adi 文件。LoTW 按「呼号: On the contact log page click "Export ADIF" to obtain an .adi file of the whole log. LoTW matches on callsign + date + time + band + mode, so even a few minutes' difference in local time defeats the match — worth checking before exporting.
